column1: Add one meal per row below. Do not change the column names.
Required fields: name, calories, protein, carbs, and fat.
Optional fields: chef, categories, and cookunity_url. Leave them blank if unknown.
Enter calories as a number. Enter protein, carbs, and fat in grams.
categories: One simple category is enough, such as Chicken, Fish, or Vegetarian.
cookunity_url: Paste the direct CookUnity meal URL, if available.
